# Amine Boularbah

> Lead Mobile Engineer & app founder based in Málaga, Spain. 6+ years building Flutter apps for iOS and Android. Currently leading a team of 5 engineers on the ground-up rebuild of the official 433 football app (77M+ fans). Founder of Receipto and Flura, two live iOS apps.

## Expertise

Flutter, Dart, Clean Architecture, BLoC, Riverpod, multi-modular monorepos, CI/CD automation (Codemagic), iOS (Swift/SwiftUI), Android, Firebase, NestJS, mobile team leadership.

## Current work

- Lead Mobile Engineer at 433 Football: leading a team of 5 engineers rebuilding the official 433 app for 77M+ football fans on iOS and Android.
- Founder of Receipto (https://receipto.app): AI-powered receipt scanner and expense manager for iOS. OCR across 162+ currencies, Magic Email inbox, tax-ready PDF/CSV/Excel exports. 400+ App Store ratings, recurring revenue.
- Founder of Flura (https://flura.app): health tracking app for people with chronic conditions (fibromyalgia, PCOS, endometriosis, long COVID, lupus, ME/CFS). 60-second daily symptom logging, pattern detection, physician-formatted PDF reports. Encrypted, GDPR compliant.
